acceptance: Unit tests cover: no drift passes; fully covered fresh drift passes; one uncovered path fails; covered drift older than 24h fails; failing or missing validate-bundles status fails; a mirror PR based on a stale published-results tip fails; a GitHub lookup error fails closed
Both workflows call the same script; no inline copy remains
Workflow permissions add only the read scopes the lookup needs
docs/internal/dev-loop-property-ledger.md rows for nightly-v2.yml and corpus-drift-check.yml still describe their behaviour
A dispatch of nightly-v2.yml with run_drift=true or corpus-drift-check.yml on develop after merge shows the expected verdict for the live state
Decision gate: if the lookup needs a token or permission beyond GITHUB_TOKEN read scopes, stop and ask the owner
context: Guardrails: work only in linked worktrees; never git add -A; Joe Harris identity, no agent trailers; no explanatory code/YAML comments (make comment-policy-check); no new CI skips, no required-check renames, no ruleset/settings/secret changes; no weakening of an existing check beyond the rule this item names; durable commit text without tracker ids.
description:
The nightly t3:drift corpus subcheck (.github/workflows/nightly-v2.yml) and the duplicate scheduled .github/workflows/corpus-drift-check.yml fail whenever develop's results-data is ahead of published-results, which is normal until a maintainer publishes the draft mirror PR. Owner chose a grace rule.

Rule: stale paths (develop-ahead or content-changed, same pathspecs as today) pass only if all hold: an open PR from sync-results-data-to-published.yml targets published-results at its current tip; its head tree has develop's exact blob for every stale path; its corpus-mirror/validate-bundles status is success; and the oldest unpublished develop change among the stale paths is less than 24 hours old. Age comes from develop history, so a newer superseding mirror PR cannot reset it. Anything else fails as today, with the same remediation text. Published-only paths stay a notice.

Implement once in a script (for example scripts/corpus_drift.py) used by both workflows, replacing both inline copies; fail closed on any lookup error.

Scope: .github/workflows/nightly-v2.yml (drift step, its permissions and fetch depth), .github/workflows/corpus-drift-check.yml, the new script and its unit tests, tests/unit/scripts/test_corpus_drift_canary.py, workflow tests that pin these steps, docs/internal/nightly-t3.md, docs/internal/results-phase-2-runbook.md.
